BEYOND TRANSPARENCY

The real question is
what a better system
makes possible.

A stronger economy. A more credible institution. A community with a reason to participate.

Transparency matters because of the decisions it improves. Formalisation matters when it makes lawful participation viable. Digital systems matter when institutions can use them to act.

Our advisory focus connects these building blocks to the deeper purpose of reform: productive livelihoods, accountable public institutions and mineral value chains that contribute more to development.

FORMALISATION AS A DEVELOPMENT PATHWAY

A SYSTEM PEOPLE CAN CHOOSE TO JOIN

Formalisation is
an economic question.
And a human one.

A register alone cannot resolve the reasons people operate outside formal systems. The pathway must connect institutional requirements with the realities of livelihoods, production and trade.

We examine the full journey: legal recognition, responsible operations, credible records, quality assurance and access to formal buyers.
